backcard_card_name: SS4 Son Goku, Returned from Hell
backcard_card_text:
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 2 cards, choose 1 card from your hand and place it on top of your deck, and this card gets +5000 power for the battle.
[Activate : Main] Add up to 1 {Android 18, Defender of Heroes} from your deck to your hand, shuffle your deck, then choose 1 card in your hand and place it on top of your deck; negate this skill for the game.
[Activate : Main][Once per turn][Spirit Boost 1] (You must remove a marker from your Unison Card to activate this skill.) Reveal the top card of your deck and place it in your Drop Area.
card_text:
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card.
[Auto] If you have 2 or more energy : When a yellow Battle Card is revealed from the top of your deck, placed in your Drop Area, and played by that card's skill, you may flip this card over. If you do, draw 1 card, switch up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode, then add cards from your life to your hand until you have 5 life left.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less : You may draw 2 cards and flip this card over.
